<!-- Generated by a multi-agent full-app audit (10 finders + red-team + synthesis), 2026-06-03. Tier 3 reference: a point-in-time review, not a directive. -->

# Robogame full-app code review

## Verdict

Robogame is **healthy with localized debt**, not spaghettifying. The asmdef graph is clean and acyclic exactly as advertised, and the project's own invariants (single Rigidbody, zero-baseline-cost, static-reset-on-domain-reload, no-per-frame-alloc in hot paths) are followed with unusual consistency across Movement, Combat, Voxel, and Core. The real risk is concentrated in two places: **the weapon subsystem's parallel-maintenance debt** (adding one weapon touches 7+ hand-synced sites with zero compiler help, and the four weapon blocks copy-paste their stat-resolution, aim-rig, and fire-gate code), and **netcode-readiness gaps that the doc comments currently overstate** — most acutely a CSP replay path that calls global `Physics.Simulate` and will double-step the whole scene the moment loose debris exists during a reconcile. Secondary risk is a cluster of god classes (`ArenaController`, `DigZone`, `FollowCamera`, `GameplayScaffolder`) — but only `ArenaController` and the weapon fork are genuine SRP violations; `DigZone` and `Robot` are large-but-cohesive. Doc-drift is real and worth a sweep: `physics.md §2` describes a rope architecture that no longer exists, and a fully-built `NetworkSceneFlow` is dead code the netcode doc credits as shipped.

## By theme

**Spaghettification** — Mostly clean. The dependency layering holds, and the load-bearing logic (MatchController, BuildSession, BlockEditor, ProjectileWorld integrator, the Burst mesher) is cleanly separated into testable models with thin drivers. The few tangles are local: `ProjectileWorld.DispatchImpactFx` braids impact-FX + terrain cratering + asset loading into one switch arm, and `ModuleSystem.Activate` hardwires VFX/audio per kind at the call site, half-breaking its own "stateless executor" boundary.

**Demodularization (god classes)** — The genuine offender is the **weapon fork**: four near-identical `*Block` classes and four `*Definition` SOs sharing no base type, plus `ArenaController` (~1,430 lines, four responsibilities — player-spawn, match-lifecycle, a battery of dummy/stress spawners, and bot-target binding). `DigZone` (~1,470 lines) and `Robot` are large but cohesive — watch, don't refactor. `FollowCamera` and `GameplayScaffolder` are the next tier. Procedural-UGUI helpers (`EnsureFolder`, `NewChild`, `EnsureEventSystem`) are copy-pasted across 6–13 files with behavioral drift.

**Future-proofing** — This is where the most findings cluster, almost all netcode-shaped. Adding a weapon, a module, or a chassis preset all require editing multiple hand-synced lists with no compiler enforcement, and several have **already drifted** (`ModuleMines` missing from variants, `GrappleMagnet` missing from `IsWeaponBlock` and the client-silence pass, HoverTank preset wired but never built). World-Y axis assumptions in `WheelBlock`/`GroundDriveSubsystem`/`PlaneControlSubsystem` block spherical arenas (the in-repo reference fix already exists in `HoverBladeBlock`).

**Performance** — Hot-path discipline is strong: static raycast/overlap buffers, packed swap-remove arrays, zero-alloc Burst meshing. The residual violations are real but bounded: `Camera.main` every frame in `DigZone.RefreshLod` (which also triggers a full 36-chunk rebuild on any LOD transition), splash damage allocating a `BlockBehaviour[]` per explosion, a HashSet-enumerator boxing in the WaterArena `Update`, and a few `GetComponentInParent` ancestor-walks in aim/reticle code.

**Correctness** — A handful of genuine bugs, mostly latent under singleplayer/loopback. The CSP `Physics.Simulate` double-step is the sharpest. `Robot.HandleBlockRemoving` deducts raw mass where aggregates used scaled `EffectiveMass`, drifting replicated health tiers. Multi-drill chassis get stuck kinematic. Several friendly-fire / gravity-convention predicates are forked and can silently diverge. `VfxSpawner.ResetStatics` leaks owned materials across domain reload.

**Doc-drift** — Real and worth one focused pass. `physics.md §2` is the headline (rope is Verlet now, not joint chains — and wrong for RotorBlock too). `NetworkSceneFlow` is credited as shipped but is orphaned dead code. `DigZone` class remarks describe a superseded full-rebuild path. Six user-facing error strings point at a retired build menu. Stale `PHYSICS_PLAN` cross-references litter Movement.

## Findings (ranked)

### CRITICAL

1. **CRITICAL · Correctness · CSP replay double-steps the whole scene** — `Network/Robot/NetworkRobotMovement.cs:226-232` — Replay loop calls global `Physics.Simulate(dt)` per tick with no `simulationMode == Script` guard, advancing every Rigidbody (debris, remote chassis, planet) on each reconcile. Breaks the instant `Robot.DetachAsDebris` spawns loose bodies during a reconcile. **Fix:** integrate only this Rigidbody by hand during replay (predict local player only); do not use the global step.

### HIGH

2. **HIGH · Correctness · `Robot.HandleBlockRemoving` deducts raw mass, aggregates used scaled** — `Robot/Robot.cs:543` vs `:367,:470-477` — Fast-path subtracts `Definition.Mass`; aggregates accumulate `EffectiveMass` (aero/hover scaled up to 6×). Clean single-block removals leave `_rb.mass` and the replicated health tier drifted. **Fix:** deduct `EffectiveMass(block)` or call `RecalculateAggregates()`; add a test on an oversized-wing chassis.

3. **HIGH · Demodularization · Weapon stat-resolution + aim-rig + fire-gate copy-pasted across 4 blocks, no shared base** — `ProjectileGun.cs:87-97`, `CannonBlock.cs:107-164`, `MortarBlock.cs:133-186`, `BombBayBlock.cs:86-120`, `GrappleMagnetBlock.cs:259-292`; the four `*Definition` SOs share ~7 fields with no common type (proven by `WeaponAmmoState.ResolveAmmoConfig:371-385`'s four-way try-cast). The yaw/pitch yoke is byte-identical across `WeaponBlock`/`CannonBlock`/`MortarBlock`/`GrappleMagnet`, all hardcoding `Vector3.up` (a latent spherical-arena bug). The "fork not subclass" decision covered stats/geometry, not this mechanical rig. **Fix:** `IWeaponStats`/`abstract WeaponStatsDefinition` for the shared fields; extract a `TurretYoke` aim stepper (fixes the `Vector3.up` bug in one place) and a `WeaponFireGate` struct.

4. **HIGH · Future-proofing · Adding a weapon requires hand-syncing 7+ uncoordinated lists; already drifted** — `RobotWeaponBinder.cs:35-73`, `WeaponAmmoState.cs:279-286`, `BlockConnectivity.cs:31-50`, `NetworkRobotCombat.cs:143-149`, `BlockDefinitionWizard.cs`, `BlockIds.cs` — `IsWeaponBlock` and the client-silence pass both already omit `GrappleMagnet`; new weapons ship client-enabled (fire regression) until someone adds a line. **Fix:** a single `Dictionary<string,WeaponKindMeta>` (or read `BlockDefinition.Category==Weapon` + a `RequiresAmmo` flag); add an `IClientSilenceable` marker so the client-silence pass is one compiler-discoverable query.

5. **HIGH · Correctness · HoverTank preset wired into HUD but blueprint never built** — `GameplayScaffolder.cs:40,862,893` vs `:82-139` — Slot 8 assigned, but no `BuildHoverTankPlan`/`CreateOrUpdateBlueprint` exists; the on-disk asset is an un-regenerable orphan. `GameStateController.SelectPreset:201` swallows the null — clicking HoverTank silently does nothing. **Fix:** author `BuildHoverTankPlan` + the create call so it's reproducible like the other nine.

6. **HIGH · Correctness · `VfxSpawner.ResetStatics` leaks owned materials across domain reload** — `VfxSpawner.cs:76-81,243-292` — Nulls only `s_instance`/`s_root`; the two `new Material(...)` statics and `s_cubeMesh` survive reload, orphaning native GPU objects under reload-disabled play. **Fix:** `Object.Destroy` the two owned materials then null all three (do NOT destroy the borrowed cube `sharedMesh`).

7. **HIGH · Performance · `Camera.main` every frame + full-zone rebuild on any LOD transition** — `DigZone.cs:333,352-374,1337-1353` — `Camera.main` tag-search every `Update` (`_enableLod` defaults true), and `RefreshLod` calls `RebuildAllMeshes()` (all 36 chunks: re-apron, re-mesh, async re-bake, occupancy rebuild, full dig-mask) whenever any chunk crosses a band. **Fix:** cache `Camera.main` in `OnEnable`; scope the rebuild through the existing `RebuildChangedChunks` machinery to only LOD-changed chunks + apron consumers.

8. **HIGH · Performance · Splash damage allocates `BlockBehaviour[]` per explosion** — `ProjectileWorld.cs:466` — `robot.GetComponentsInChildren<BlockBehaviour>` allocates per splash hit (every bomb/mortar/mine), contradicting the file's own "zero allocations" header. **Fix (corrected per red-team):** `BlockGrid._blocks` is private and `grid.Blocks` is a dictionary whose `foreach` would itself box — so cache a per-robot block array invalidated alongside `InvalidateOwnerColliders`, not a naive `grid.Blocks` foreach.

9. **HIGH · Future-proofing · Carve path has no server-authority gate** — `DrillBlock.cs:338`, `TerrainCratering.cs:38`, `DigZone.cs:993/1032`, `ProjectileWorld.cs:582` — No `Scripts/Voxel/` file references `IsServer`/`NetworkContext`; clients mutate the authoritative SDF directly and `BrushOp.serverTick` is hardcoded `0` everywhere (checkpoint compaction is dead until a server stamps ticks). Documented Phase-6 debt, not a silent violation. **Fix:** add a one-line "client-predicted; server apply lands Phase 6" note at each emitter so the retrofit point is obvious.

### MEDIUM

10. **MEDIUM · Future-proofing · Edge inputs use `WasPressedThisFrame`, not tick-latched** — `Input/PlayerInputHandler.cs:74-130`, `NetworkRobotMovement.cs:226-233` — Frame-scoped edge detection captured into fixed-tick commands; replaying a single-shot weapon re-triggers once per replayed tick. **Fix:** latch edge actions per-fixed-tick, or exclude single-shot weapons from replay.

11. **MEDIUM · Future-proofing · `NetworkSceneFlow` fully built but orphaned** — `Network/Bootstrap/NetworkSceneFlow.cs:44-145` vs `NetworkBootstrap.cs:223-245` — Nothing spawns it; `NetworkBootstrap` duplicates the connect→load→spawn flow, so the §10 round-phase replication and late-join destruction replay the doc credits as shipped never run. **Fix:** promote it to the single flow owner (on a spawned NetworkObject) and delete the bootstrap dup, or delete the class and fold replay into bootstrap.

12. **MEDIUM · Doc-drift · `physics.md §2` describes a retired rope architecture** — `docs/subsystems/physics.md:46-146` vs `RopeBlock.cs:8,560` — Rope is Verlet now (one chassis↔tip leash joint remains); RotorBlock uses a kinematic hub with no joint chain. The "don't write damage code until migration lands" trigger is obsolete — it landed. **Fix:** rewrite §2 to current state, move joint-chain content to a Historical note.

13. **MEDIUM · Future-proofing · World-Y baked into ground/plane drive + wheel suspension** — `WheelBlock.cs:160-198`, `GroundDriveSubsystem.cs:177-259`, `PlaneControlSubsystem.cs:153` — Spherical-arenas doc enumerates every substitution; `HoverBladeBlock` (`GravityField.SampleAt`) is the in-repo reference. Known gap, not a flat-arena bug. **Fix:** cache `localUp = -GravityField.SampleAt(pos).normalized` at each `Tick` top when spherical Phase A starts.

14. **MEDIUM · Correctness · Multi-drill chassis gets stuck kinematic** — `DrillBlock.cs:440-521,155-162` — Each drill snapshots `_glidePrevKinematic` independently; drill B records drill A's already-kinematic `true` and never restores dynamic. `RobotDrillBinder` caps no drill count. **Fix:** reference-count glides at a chassis-level coordinator (e.g. `DrillCollisionForwarder`); capture the pre-glide flag once.

15. **MEDIUM · Correctness · Friendly-fire / EMP / gravity predicates forked and divergent** — `ProjectileWorld.cs:453-458` vs `ModuleEffects.cs:419-424` (friendly-fire); `ModuleEffects.cs:50-68` (EMP checks only `==owner`, hits teammates, queries `~0`); `BombBayBlock.cs:134` (world-down) vs `CannonBlock.cs:219` / `MortarBlock.cs:202` (chassis-relative). **Fix:** one `Teams.AreHostile(Robot,Robot)` predicate routed through all sites; a `ProjectileGravity.ForMuzzle` helper so the gravity convention is one documented choice.

16. **MEDIUM · Correctness · Blueprint validator diverges from the runtime placement gate** — `BlueprintValidator.cs:106-124` vs `BlockConnectivity.cs:142-198` — Rule 4 calls `IsConnectiveFace`, missing `AcceptsPlacement`'s mechanism-cube lateral-aero and rope-tip restrictions; a hand-edited blueprint can mount a thruster on a rotor-hosted cube's lateral face. **Fix:** route rule 4 through an entries-based `AcceptsPlacement`, or downgrade the "same rules" doc claim.

17. **MEDIUM · Correctness · `ScrapDepot` mutates the shared (default) material at runtime** — `ScrapDepot.cs:519-523` — `r.sharedMaterial.EnableKeyword("_EMISSION")` leaks the keyword to every renderer sharing Unity's default material and dirties the asset in-editor. **Fix:** enable via the MPB already used for color, or instantiate one per-depot material.

18. **MEDIUM · Correctness · `NameplateOverlay.FormatName` allocates strings every OnGUI** — `NameplateOverlay.cs:159-169` — `EndsWith`/`Substring`/`TrimEnd` per visible robot ×2/frame; name only changes on respawn. **Fix:** memoize per-Robot in `RefreshRobotList` (the sibling `ScrapCarriedIndicator` already does this).

19. **MEDIUM · Performance · WaterArena `Update` boxes a HashSet enumerator** — `WaterMeshAnimator.cs:164`, `BuoyancyController.cs:48` — `foreach` over `IReadOnlyCollection<>` boxes the struct enumerator once/frame. **Fix:** expose `Active` as the concrete `HashSet` or a parallel `List`.

20. **MEDIUM · Performance · A* allocates ~5 full-grid arrays per call** — `OccupancyGrid.cs:251-272` — Latent (no runtime caller until Phase 5 AI), but invariant-#6-breaking once AI paths in `FixedUpdate`. **Fix:** pool the search buffers, `Array.Clear` instead of `new`; switch the O(N²) open set to a heap before AI ships.

21. **MEDIUM · Performance · `PollBakeAndSwap` can leave the collider stale unbounded** — `DigChunk.cs:290-298` — Gates on `IsCompleted` with no frame fence; visible mesh shows the tunnel while the MeshCollider keeps the pre-dig surface. Non-drill interactions (crater rims) get no workaround. **Fix:** force `_bakeHandle.Complete()` after N pending frames; document the worst-case window.

22. **MEDIUM · Performance · Aim/mount `GetComponentInParent` walks every frame** — `AimReticle.cs:104`, `WeaponMount.cs:89` — `localRobot`/`self` resolved fresh per frame though they only change on respawn. **Fix:** cache on target-change (mirror the existing `_ammoCacheTarget` pattern).

23. **MEDIUM · Correctness · Module-ready SFX gated behind `IsServer`** — `ModuleSystem.cs:140,153` — The whole `Update` bails on `!IsServer` before playing the local ready-cue; pure clients go silent under netcode. **Fix:** split server-authoritative cooldown tick from locally-driven cue playback (off replicated `CooldownRemaining`).

24. **MEDIUM · Future-proofing · `ModuleSystem.Activate` switch hardwires VFX/audio per kind** — `ModuleSystem.cs:164-232` — Eight cases each pair the gameplay call with `VfxSpawner.Spawn`+`AudioRouter`, and two embed lifetime state, half-breaking the "pure gameplay" boundary. **Fix:** data-driven per-kind descriptor (vfxKind, cue) so the switch shrinks to gameplay dispatch.

25. **MEDIUM · Future-proofing · Module id↔kind is four hand-synced switches; Mines and leaf-status already drifted** — `ModuleKinds.cs:14-66`, `BlockVariants.cs:26-41`, `BlockConnectivity.cs:31-50` — `ModuleMines` missing from `s_hardcodedVariableIds` (VAR badge vs panel disagree); no module is a leaf (build-on-top-of-EMP allowed). **Fix:** one `(id,kind,label)[]` table; derive variant-ness and leaf-default from `ModuleKinds.IsModuleId`; confirm module leaf intent with the user.

26. **MEDIUM · Future-proofing · `NetworkContext.Register` silently overwrites; not thread-safe** — `NetworkContext.cs:32,45-53` — A double-register replaces the authority gate with zero diagnostic. **Fix:** warn/assert when overwriting a different non-null context.

27. **MEDIUM · Correctness · `AudioRouter._loops` never sweeps caller-leaked handles** — `AudioRouter.cs:99,287-322` — A block destroyed without `Stop()` leaves a fake-null handle forever; `_loops` grows unbounded over a combat session. **Fix:** sweep dead `_source` in `Update` (mirror the existing voice sweep).

28. **MEDIUM · Spaghetti · `ArenaController` is ~1,430 lines / 4 responsibilities** — `ArenaController.cs:199-1420` — Player-spawn + match-lifecycle + a battery of dummy/stress spawners + bot-target binding, with 80+ serialized fields. **Fix:** extract `ArenaDummySpawner` (the `Stress.*`-gated test scaffolding) and a `MatchRoster` helper; leaves spawn + match orchestration.

29. **MEDIUM · Spaghetti · `DigZone` is a 1,467-line god class** — `DigZone.cs` — Cohesive but carries eight concerns. **Fix (watch, low-priority):** extract the self-contained dig-mask GPU plumbing into a `DigGrassMask` helper and the op-log into `DigOpLog`; roughly halves the file without touching the mesher.

30. **MEDIUM · Demodularization · `EnsureFolder` copy-pasted into 13 editor files with NRE drift** — `BlockDefinitionWizard.cs:290` (no `IsNullOrEmpty` guard → NRE at root) vs the guarded copies — `ScaffoldUtils` exists as the designated home. **Fix:** move the most-defensive copy + `LoadOrCreateAsset` into `ScaffoldUtils`, delete the 13.

31. **MEDIUM · Future-proofing · Server cooldown keyed to one chassis-wide bucket** — `NetworkRobotCombat.cs:258` — `TryAccept(Vector3Int.zero,…)` models an 8-gun chassis as one weapon; telemetry-only today, will false-reject when promoted to a gate. **Fix:** key per weapon-block index (the param already exists); track in netcode.md Phase-4 list.

### LOW

32. **LOW · Future-proofing · Adding a chassis preset needs 5+ index-coupled edits** — `GameplayScaffolder.cs:27-45,101-135,855-895` — The HoverTank bug is the direct cost. **Fix:** drive from one ordered `(path, builder)` table; derive `arraySize` from `.Length`.

33. **LOW · Correctness · `VariantConfigPanel.BuildMode` double-subscribes `Entered`** — `VariantConfigPanel.cs:107-125,163-176`, wired from `GarageController.cs:272` per respawn — `Exited` is guarded, `Entered` is not; leaks one subscription per respawn (benign, idempotent). **Fix:** mirror the `-=` guard.

34. **LOW · Correctness · `BuildSession.SyncBlueprint` latches `RotorsGenerateLift` true** — `BuildSession.cs:466-480` — No `else`; removing the last rotor leaves the flag stale on the saved blueprint. **Fix:** `Blueprint.RotorsGenerateLift = hasRotor;`.

35. **LOW · Correctness · Splash hit-marker fires with no damageable hit** — `ProjectileWorld.cs:412-447` — `HitLanded` fires on `count>0` even when all overlaps were terrain/friendly. **Fix:** only invoke when a real target took damage.

36. **LOW · Correctness · `RotorBlock.IgnoreFoilChassisContacts` goes stale on grid mutation** — `RotorBlock.cs:753-765` — Snapshots colliders once at adopt; repair/debris colliders aren't ignored, reintroducing the yaw-at-rotor-speed pathology. **Fix:** re-run on `BlockPlaced`, or move foils to a non-colliding physics layer (also drops O(foils×colliders) `IgnoreCollision` calls).

37. **LOW · Performance · Per-rope `LiveSegmentCount`/`LiveLengthCells` do `GetComponent`+Tweakable in `FixedUpdate`** — `RopeBlock.cs:347-362,93-123` — `restLength` only changes on `Rebuild`. **Fix:** cache it into a field at `Build()` end; route the getter through cached `_block`.

38. **LOW · Correctness · `BlockGrid.HandleBlockDestroyed` re-enters `RemoveBlock`; comment lies** — `BlockGrid.cs:312-319` — Comment describes deferred removal; code is synchronous inside the damage callback (re-entrancy guarded only by `Destroyed -= `). **Fix:** correct the comment, note the re-entrancy assumption.

39. **LOW · Demodularization · Tip-block identity `Hook||Mace||Magnet` open-coded in 7 sites** — `BlockGraph.cs:281/310/350`, `BlockConnectivity.cs:192`, `PlacementRules.cs:294`, `BlockEditor.cs:452`, `RobotWeaponBinder.cs:31`, `RobotTipBlockBinder.cs:26` — `IsTipBlockId` exists but is private. **Fix:** promote one `BlockTaxonomy.IsTipBlock(id)` predicate.

40. **LOW · Spaghetti · Rope-bridge BFS triplicated** — `BlockGraph.cs:272-368` — Three near-identical helpers with subtly different ignore semantics. **Fix:** parameterize one helper over an "is-ignored" predicate (the collapse already done for the core BFS).

41. **LOW · Demodularization · `FollowCamera` bundles 5 responsibilities (643 lines)** — `Player/FollowCamera.cs:300-577` — Cursor-lock + zoom + orbit + ADS + chassis-renderer hiding. **Fix:** extract `AdsController` and `CameraCursorLock`; leaves orbit+collision (~350 lines).

42. **LOW · Demodularization · Procedural-UGUI primitives duplicated across 6 HUD files; `EnsureEventSystem` ×3** — `SettingsHud.cs`, `VariantConfigPanel.cs`, `SceneTransitionHud.cs`, `MainMenuController.cs`, `PlacementFeedbackHud.cs`, `BuildMirrorMode.cs` — The §9.4 `InputSystemUIInputModule` swap lives in 3 drift-prone copies. **Fix:** a `GameplayUiBuilder` static helper.

43. **LOW · Doc-drift · Six user-facing strings cite the retired build menu** — `ArenaController.cs:217,380,1024`, `GarageController.cs:134,143`, `WaterArenaController.cs:75` — Point at `Scaffold > … > Build All Pass A`; now `Robogame > Build Everything`. **Fix:** update the strings.

44. **LOW · Doc-drift · `DigZone`/`DigChunk` class remarks describe superseded behavior** — `DigZone.cs:24-30`, `DigChunk.cs:36-38` — Claim full-rebuild + synchronous cooking; scoped `RebuildChangedChunks` and `BakeMeshJob` shipped. **Fix:** update the remark blocks.

45. **LOW · Future-proofing · `ModuleKinds.BlockIdFor`/`RowFor` silently fall back to EMP/placeholder** — `ModuleKinds.cs:43-53`, `ModuleTuning.cs:57-108` — Closed enum-keyed sets; a missing case is a programming error returning a plausible-wrong default. **Fix:** `Debug.Assert`/log in the default arm.

46. **LOW · Future-proofing · `ContentHashGuard` `<no-library>` fallback hashes identically across different content** — `ContentHashGuard.cs:57-63` — Silent-pass anti-cheat hole before Steam. **Fix:** reject the connection when the library is unresolvable rather than hashing a placeholder.

47. **LOW · Correctness · `HoverBladeBlock` computes spring term twice; un-damped value is the feedback normalizer** — `HoverBladeBlock.cs:285-337` — Feedback intensity reads low while climbing. **Fix:** reuse one spring term, or comment that `maxSpring` is the intentional un-damped ceiling.

48. **LOW · Doc-drift · Stale `physics.md §` / `PHYSICS_PLAN` cross-references in Movement** — `HoverBladeBlock.cs:19` (§6 should be §2.1), `ThrusterBlock.cs:56`, `RotorBlock.cs:427` (`PHYSICS_PLAN` → `physics.md`). **Fix:** repoint and sweep.

49. **LOW · Future-proofing · Triangle budget (invariant #10) never enforced at bake/runtime** — `DigZone.cs`, `DigZoneFormat.cs` — No worst-case tri/chunk ceiling check. **Fix:** add a `chunks × ~20K` estimate compare to the editor baker.

## Top recommendations

1. **Fix the CSP replay step (finding 1).** `Network/Robot/NetworkRobotMovement.cs`. Effort **M**. Buys the single biggest correctness landmine removed before netcode work resumes — replace the global `Physics.Simulate` with hand-integration of the local Rigidbody. Until done, mark replay loopback-only in `netcode.md §8`.

2. **Collapse the weapon fork onto a shared contract + registry (findings 3, 4, 15, and 8's sibling).** `Combat/*Block.cs`, `*Definition.cs`, `RobotWeaponBinder`, `WeaponAmmoState`, `NetworkRobotCombat`. Effort **L**. Buys the largest reduction in parallel-maintenance debt in the codebase: an `IWeaponStats` base + a single weapon-kind table + an `IClientSilenceable` marker turns "edit 7 lists, miss one, ship a fire regression" into one data edit, and fixes the already-present `GrappleMagnet` omissions. Extract `TurretYoke` in the same pass to kill the `Vector3.up` spherical bug.

3. **Fix the mass-deduction drift + add the regression test (finding 2).** `Robot/Robot.cs`. Effort **S**. Buys correct `_rb.mass` and a correct replicated health tier on scaled-aero chassis — a bug that feeds destroy-timing and networked state.

4. **Make the scaffolder preset/blueprint list table-driven (findings 5, 32).** `GameplayScaffolder.cs`. Effort **M**. Buys reproducibility of the broken HoverTank preset and makes "wired but not built" structurally impossible going forward; pairs naturally with splitting `BuildXxxPlan` into its own file.

5. **Sweep the four hot-path perf violations (findings 7, 8, 18, 19) + the two `ResetStatics`/loop leaks (6, 27).** `DigZone`, `ProjectileWorld`, `NameplateOverlay`, `WaterMeshAnimator`, `VfxSpawner`, `AudioRouter`. Effort **M** total. Buys restored zero-alloc/zero-leak posture the project's invariants advertise — each is a small, independent, high-confidence fix.

6. **Doc-drift pass (findings 11, 12, 43, 44, 48, 50).** `physics.md`, `netcode.md`, the cited class remarks and error strings; decide `NetworkSceneFlow`'s fate (promote or delete). Effort **S–M**. Buys: future agents stop making decisions from stale docs, and the dead late-join scaffold stops masquerading as shipped.

7. **Centralize the forked predicates (finding 15) and the drifted identity lists (findings 25, 39).** `Teams.AreHostile`, `ProjectileGravity.ForMuzzle`, one module table, `BlockTaxonomy.IsTipBlock`. Effort **M**. Buys protection against silent balance bugs (EMP hitting teammates, mines using a stale team rule) and removes the hand-sync drift class that already produced the `ModuleMines` and module-leaf inconsistencies.

8. **Extract `ArenaController`'s dummy/stress spawners (finding 28).** New `ArenaDummySpawner` MonoBehaviour. Effort **M**. Buys the clearest SRP win available — moves ~400 lines of `Stress.*`-gated test scaffolding out of the shipping spawn/match flow without touching the load-bearing orchestration.
